{{Top|leg}}
The '''A88 aquata breather''' was found in a standard [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[field kit]]. It was rated to provide up to two [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] worth of [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] intake, but could be calibrated to fit other [[Species/Legends|species]]' needs. While commonly used [[Water/Legends|underwater]], the aquata breather was also suitable for [[Poison/Legends|toxic]] and thin [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheres]].<ref name="The Jedi Path">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref> For example, [[Bultar Swan/Legends|Bultar Swan]] and [[Tsui Choi/Legends|Tsui Choi]] wore them on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]].<ref name="Star Wars: Purge">[[Purge (comic book)|''Purge'']]</ref>
